title: Pickers drawn over details, dialogs, radios and a scroller
blurb: Five more controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a shoe size drop-down made of a details and radios, bicycle parts in non-modal dialogs, a glaze picker on radios, a crossword row on one text input, and a tulip carousel on a scroll-snap scroller.
question: Which native elements can stand in for a select picker and a popover, which a canvas can't draw, and does a scroller drawn by a canvas still scroll and snap by itself?
result: A details with radios stands in for the select, and a dialog with the open attribute for the popover: both stay in the canvas and are drawn opening and closing. The scroll-snap element scrolled and snapped by itself while the canvas drew it, with a paint event at each step. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
